verdict.rationale: Kick ships its own CLI for running lookups and reports from the terminal, and its docs pitch MCP/CLI for automating month-end checks across workspaces, so a scripted, headless path exists. CI or unattended operation is not documented, and the MCP flow is framed around user approval rather than unattended execution. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage, non-interactive auth (API keys/service tokens), scriptable output formats, CLI write/automation command reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run accounting lookups and reports from your terminal. Authenticate, pick a workspace, and pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI.
Connect MCP or CLI to take it further: query your client data in plain language, automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace.
